verdict.rationale: BVNK documents a sandbox that mirrors production with test data for risk-free integration testing (bvnk-docs-31, bvnk-docs-28). It also offers a dedicated simulation endpoint (POST /payment/v2/payins/simulation) that gives a consistent simulation experience for pay-ins and payouts across currencies and payment methods (bvnk-docs-3, bvnk-docs-22). Missing for 10: explicit sandbox coverage of conversions/Transfers v3, documented deterministic test values (e.g., magic amounts or outcome triggers), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
